changes: Group Chat send (text and image) now actually checks whether the write succeeded. authedFetch does NOT throw on a rejected write — a Firebase permission error still resolves normally, just with res.ok=false — so without this check, a rejected write would silently proceed as if it worked: input cleared, no error shown, and the chat re-renders whatever's ACTUALLY in Firebase (which could still be empty). This is very likely the real explanation for messages repeatedly not appearing. A failure now restores your typed text and shows the actual HTTP status so it's diagnosable instead of silent.
Added the missing index on Group Chat's timestamp field, matching the pattern already used elsewhere (XP logs) — wasn't causing outright failures but was a real gap worth closing.
